findings.finding: read-only-plan.log does not contain the launch manifest sha256 or the launcher hash. Its link to this package rests only on co-location in r428-op-recovery-tests-d5d6094, the matching scenario, and payload_files=406, which equals original_install_inputs_verified. I did not re-run the launcher plan myself, because the review is read-only.

The source-test evidence records the commit but not whether the working tree was clean. The worktree is currently dirty only in docs (AGENTS.md, docs/4.2.8/*, docs/deployment/*), with no changes under src/, scripts/ or pipeline_tests/. prepare.log matches launch-prepared.json after line-ending normalization.

Behavior changes in the d5d6094 launcher from ab900e9, outside the recovery contract and noted for the owner. The previous Warden task LastRunTime check now accepts a reset value (year < 2000) in addition to the exact recorded run. The one-shot task SDDL baseline is now taken from the first fresh copy that passes the ACL policy (trust on first use) instead of from the registration object. Raw XML comparison is replaced by a structural check (Assert-OpOneShotDefinition) of triggers, action path, arguments, working directory, SYSTEM principal, RunLevel, RestartCount, MultipleInstances and ExecutionTimeLimit. These relaxations are deliberate and documented in comments.
